scope: Narrow read-only argument and register-flow challenge of the group-member accessor rate setter and selected reference getter; not complete provider or application integration review.

findings.detail: 1002d91a4 keeps incoming manager in x21; each loop constructs a member AudioAccessor in x22. At1002d9300..931c manager virtual+140 returns S0 and member accessor virtual+f0 receives that unchanged Float32 argument. This is a manager/reference-derived rate, not a project-rate argument.

1002d9034 loads index+38, indexes 16-byte entries at+20, forwards selected entry object+140; null selected object returns0.1002d8c20 writes that index only when incoming W3 is nonzero and valid member/index gates pass.

In1002eeea8 X23 initially holds incoming X3, but1002eefa4 overwrites X23 with the first collected entry before the loop.1002ef07c compares that first entry with enumerated X26;1002ef080 passes equality asW3. This supports first-collected-reference selection, not automatic identity with the original incoming/current event.

limits: The collection ordering, cached manager reuse, all source/provider selections and effective hosted group membership are outside this narrow review.
Vtable identities are author-supplied source bindings; this review independently read the retained instruction argument flows but did not rerun their full binder.
